text:
Jules R: Quick one  I did a 3-city customer trip (Berlin > Amsterdam > Zurich). Corporate card got blocked in AMS so I paid dinners and a taxi on personal card for two nights. Also got a VAT refund form from a vendor in DE; they gave me a paper form (not stamped yet). How do I file everything?
Anita (People Ops): Sorry about the block. Short checklist: 1) Upload itemized receipts for each expense. 2) For taxis without a merchant receipt, add a short attestation and manager approval. 3) Keep the VAT refund form and submit it; Finance will deduct any refunded VAT from the claim if/when you get a refund.
Jules R: The dinners are in different currencies (EUR and CHF). Do I need to convert?
Finance Ops Bot: No manual conversion needed. Submit receipts in original currency. The expense system will apply the official conversion rate on submission. If you prefer, include the card transaction screenshot showing the charged amount and FX conversion.
Raj P: For the corporate card block  do we need a support ticket to unblock?
Anita (People Ops): Finance blocked the charge due to a vendor mismatch flag. We flagged it as a legitimate business expense and asked card provider to whitelist vendor. For now, reimbursement is fastest. If you want Finance to pay the vendor directly (to keep it off your personal ledger) we can request an invoice reissue and run it through procurement, but that adds ~5 business days.
Jules R: VAT form  it's a pink export form from the shop in Berlin but the customs stamp will only be added when I hand it in at the airport. I can't get it stamped until I fly out. Should I still upload now?
Finance Ops Bot: Upload the un-stamped VAT form now as "pending VAT refund" and add a note: expected refund, airport customs stamp pending. When you receive the refund or stamp, upload an update. Finance will hold the VAT amount as a pending credit until the refund is confirmed.
Jules R: For the taxi attestation, what's the minimum info?
Anita (People Ops): Include date, city, pickup/dropoff points, amount, and a brief note that the corporate card declined. Manager approval required. Use this tiny template if helpful:

```
Taxi attestation
Employee: Jules R
Date: 2026-06-03
City: Amsterdam
Route: Schiphol 75 City Center (Hotel)
Amount: 22.40
Reason: Corporate card declined; driver provided no printed receipt. Manager: Raj P
```

Jules R: Awesome. Any special treatment for per-diem for partial travel days? I had an all-day customer workshop in Zurich (covered lunch) but had dinner on personal card.
Finance Ops Bot: Per diem rules apply: travel days pro-rate at 50%. Business-provided meals (e.g., workshop lunch) reduce the per-diem accordingly. Claim the dinner receipt under Meals and indicate the workshop lunch was provided so per-diem is adjusted.
Raj P: One more small thing  I paid a checked bag fee with my personal card because the flight change forced it. Is that reimbursable?
Anita (People Ops): Checked bag fees for business trips are reimbursable. Attach the airline receipt (or booking confirmation showing fee). If it was due to voluntary upgrades we may decline; if due to itinerary change or necessity, it's fine.
Jules R: Naming uploads? I want to keep things tidy for Finance.
Anita (People Ops): Use: YYYYMMDD_city_vendor_amount_currency (e.g., 20260603_Amsterdam_taxi_22.40_EUR). For VAT forms append _VAT (e.g., 20260601_Berlin_shop_VAT). Mark pending items in the Notes field.
Finance Ops Bot: Reminder: receipts older than 60 days require an exception. Tag "expenses-late" and include a brief reason.
Jules R: Thanks all. I'll assemble and ping @Anita if anything looks off before submission. :thumbsup:
